title: Flisk Project Configuration
description: Editor assistance for .flisk/project.json. The Flisk CLI remains the runtime source of truth.

minFliskVersion.description: Oldest flisk CLI this project works with, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. flisk doctor fails on an older CLI.

minTdkVersion.description: Deprecated alias for minFliskVersion. Use minFliskVersion instead.

pinnedFliskVersion.description: Exact flisk CLI version this project requires, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

project.description: Project metadata identifying the application name and version.

name.description: Name of the project, used to prefix generated Docker resources, volumes, networks, and subdomains.

version.description: Semantic version of the project application.

phases.description: Lifecycle phases that group service stacks into progressive deployment and focus milestones.

stacks.description: Deprecated alias for phases; maps phase names to services for backwards compatibility.

always_enabled_infra.description: Platform infrastructure resources flisk up always starts, independent of the phase stacks and focus mode (default: database-management and proxy).

repos.description: External Git repositories whose code belongs to services in this project. flisk up clones any repo whose destination directory is missing.

url.description: Git repository clone URL (e.g. git@github.com:acme/orders-api.git or https://github.com/acme/orders-api.git).

dir.description: Destination directory relative to project root (e.g. services/shop/orders-api).

branch.description: Optional branch expectation to clone or verify.

composeProjectNames.description: Stack name to the Compose project name its services ran under before flisk import (docker compose -p), written by flisk import so an existing install can be found. Flisk accepts it; it does not change the generated project name yet.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts outside the local stack that env values may point at on purpose (a payment sandbox, a model API). flisk doctor does not report them. "*.example.com" matches every subdomain.

capabilities.description: Platform capabilities the project can turn off; each flag is on by default and setting one to false changes what Flisk provisions.

gateway.description: Whether to provision the Traefik reverse proxy and gateway routing.

database.description: Whether to provision the bundled shared PostgreSQL (database-management). A service that declares dependsOn postgres still gets it.

optional_infra.description: Optional infrastructure toggles; each flag provisions the matching platform service and all are off by default except golden_image.

monitoring.description: Whether to provision the observability platform (SigNoz or SkyWalking) for metrics, traces and logs.

elk.description: Whether to provision the Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana stack for log aggregation and analysis.

debezium.description: Whether to provision Debezium change data capture for streaming database changes in real time (requires the shared PostgreSQL).

golden_image.description: Whether to build the shared golden Docker image layers that service images reuse for faster builds.

verdaccio.description: Whether to provision the Verdaccio npm registry for local package publishing (premium; requires FLISK_LICENSE_KEY).

discovery.description: Service discovery configuration: where Flisk scans for service.json manifests.

paths.description: Directory glob patterns scanned for service.json manifests (for example services/*/*), also written to the root package.json workspaces list.

overrides.description: Free-form project-level overrides the CLI preserves verbatim when it reads and rewrites .flisk/project.json.

tiltignore.description: Edits to the generated .tiltignore: exclude removes generated pattern lines and extra appends project-specific ones.

extra.description: Pattern lines appended to the generated .tiltignore.

exclude.description: Generated pattern lines to remove, matched after trimming whitespace.
